d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how deadly attacks targeting Christians in Ethiopia have sparked sharp international alarm and mounting US pressure on Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. Following lethal assaults against Orthodox Christians in Ethiopia’s Oromia region and Arsi zone—including deadly attacks across districts such as Merti, Shirka, and Robe that left families grieving, homes burned, and communities displaced—church leaders, human rights voices, and US officials have condemned the violence.
